title: Grateful Dead Live at Aztec Bowl, San Diego State U. on 1969-05-11
venue: Aztec Bowl, San Diego State U.
lineage: DAT (Sony PCM-R500) > Tascam DA-3000 > Adobe Audition 2022 > Samplitude Pro X6 Suite > FLAC/48k

ai_review.summary: Rough FM broadcast captures an energized spring‑groove performance, but the mix is uneven and often muddy.
ai_review.review: The tape is a gritty FM broadcast that occasionally clears up, giving listeners a glimpse of the band’s high‑energy playing in the spring groove. While Garcia’s extended percussion work and the overall drive are praised, the recording quality limits full enjoyment, leaving fans hoping for a proper soundboard source.

ai_rating.rationale: Review highlights strong musical energy (≈4/5) but notes rough, uneven recording quality (≈2/5). Weighted average yields a mid‑range rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Rough FM tape with occasional clean sections; overall muddy and inconsistent mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Band sounds very energized in a spring‑groove feel, though the recording makes it hard to assess pacing or transitions.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia leads an extended percussion ensemble with progressive playing that stands out.
band_member_comments.Drums: More drums and cowbell are noted; the percussion section is highlighted as especially active.
